title: Florida Woman Calls 911 For The Most Bizarre Reason
description:
Bodycam footage shows a Florida woman being confronted by deputies after calling 911 for the most bizarre reason in March. The Lee County Sheriff’s Office received a call from Christy Turman, who appeared to be babbling nonsense before claiming she was trying to steal a car that was “not legally” hers. When deputies arrived, Turman waved them down and began going on wild tangents in the parking lot of a Cadillac dealership. She was eventually arrested for trespassing in a conveyance.
